refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.intro: If you are unable to install and use eSIM due to technical issues that are the fault of skyfi.vn, you have the right to request a refund or modification.

section1.title: 1. REFUNDS AND CANCELLATIONS
section1.content1:
1.1.2. When activation is no longer possible after thorough troubleshooting, a refund request may be made within thirty (30) days of the purchase date.

1.1.3. If the eSIM has been activated and there is an issue for which skyfi.vn is responsible and/or the mobile operator has acknowledged cannot be quickly resolved, you may be refunded for the remaining data.

1.1.4. Early customer cooperation in problem resolution is extremely important for receiving a refund.

1.1.5. Each data package has its own validity period. Remaining data will not be eligible for refund in any form after expiration.

1.1.6. Compensation: No refunds or payments of any kind will be made for additional telephone charges, additional SIM cards, or additional hotel telephone charges.

1.1.7. Fraudulent Purchases: If there are any signs of misuse, violation of our terms and conditions, or any fraudulent actions related to the use of skyfi.vn products and services, skyfi.vn reserves the right to refuse any form of refund.

1.1.8. Unauthorized Purchases: Before processing any refund, the issue will be investigated and approved. Any orders related to fraud may be suspended by skyfi.vn at its discretion.

1.1.9. Incorrect Charges: If a customer reasonably and in good faith disputes an invoice or a portion of an invoice, the customer must notify skyfi.vn of the dispute within 10 business days of receiving the invoice. The notification must include information about why the customer believes the amount charged is incorrect as well as, if possible, the amount that the customer believes is owed.

1.1.10. skyfi.vn will not accept refund requests in the following cases:
The customer has deleted the eSIM and wants to reinstall it.
The customer's device does not support eSIM.
The customer's phone is network locked.
The eSIM has expired (The expiration date is stated in the order confirmation email).
The country you are visiting has force majeure circumstances (including but not limited to natural disasters, earthquakes, epidemics, fires, wars, strikes, riots, changes in local legal policies, changes in government...).
The network infrastructure of the travel countries has issues, is not yet stable.
The customer does not proactively contact skyfi.vn when an eSIM issue occurs.

1.1.11. Other Reasons: If the refund request does not fall under one of the categories mentioned above, we will consider each request separately. If a refund is granted, there may be a processing fee. The maximum credit or refund that a consumer can request must be equal to or less than their total purchase price.

section2.title: 1.2. REFUND PROCESS
section2.content:
Customers contact the skyfi.vn support team via hotline: 1900 6605 or send an email to support@skyfi.vn to make a refund request.

Refund Deadline: skyfi.vn will only refund Customers when skyfi.vn confirms that it is not possible to install and use eSIM due to technical issues that are the fault of skyfi.vn and the customer has the right to request a refund.

How to get your money back: Depending on the case, the refund will be transferred to the Customer's designated credit card/bank account or by the method agreed upon by both parties.

Please note that the above refund policy will apply. Customers may be required to provide additional information to support their refund request, depending on the nature of the issue, such as screenshots of device settings for technical issues, an explanation of why the amount billed is incorrect and if possible, an estimate of how much the customer believes is owed.

section3.title: 2. MODIFICATIONS
section3.content:
Once obtained, eSIM data packages from skyfi.vn cannot be changed or customized based on specific requests; they are provided as is.

For more detailed information, please contact the skyfi.vn Customer Care Department or please contact: 1900 6605 for assistance. Thank you!

section1.title: I. PAYMENT REGULATIONS
section1.subtitle1: Review and Confirmation of Payment Terms
section1.content1:
Skyfi.vn has a mechanism that allows customers to review, supplement, modify, and confirm transaction content before using the payment function to send a payment agreement proposal. This review and confirmation mechanism meets the following conditions:

Displays the following information to customers:

a) Name of goods or services, quantity, brand, and price;

b) Method and deadline for delivery of goods or provision of services;

c) Total contract value and details related to the payment method chosen by the customer.

This information can be stored, printed from the customer's information system, and displayed later.

Displays to customers information about how to respond accepting the contract proposal and the deadline for responding to the contract proposal through confirmation contact via hotline.

Allows customers, after reviewing the above information, to choose to cancel the transaction or confirm the proposal to enter into a contract through the website or hotline.
section1.content3:
Skyfi.vn has published all payment methods applicable to goods so that customers can understand and choose the appropriate payment method in the Payment Policy section.

Skyfi.vn has established a mechanism for customers using the online payment function to review and confirm detailed information about each payment transaction before making the payment.

Skyfi.vn ensures the safety and security of customer payment transactions, handles complaints, and compensates for damages in case the customer's payment information through the website is changed, deleted, canceled, copied, disclosed, illegally moved, or appropriated causing damage to the customer.

section2.title: II. PAYMENT METHODS
section2.content:
**Advance payment method:**

Currently, Skyfi accepts payment forms: International VISA card, domestic Napas card. You can completely check the goods before paying.

**Note:** Before proceeding with the order, customers please carefully check the information about the products to be purchased along with the amount to be paid, which is clearly displayed in the order information form on the website interface.

You can also pay when shopping at SKYFI.VN by:

- Payment via international VISA card, domestic Napas card is applied to orders nationwide. Customers enter their card information to confirm and pay directly. Money will be transferred to the bank account of GALAXY DIGITAL HOLDINGS LLC:

Immediately after receiving confirmation notification from the bank, SKYFI.VN will notify the customer and proceed with delivery.

Customers can order through the website: https://Skyfi.vn / or via Hotline: 1900 6605. Our staff will call to confirm with customers about products and shipping methods.
